data.hypothesis: For larger n, one cooperative launch can reduce the intermediate traffic and repeated launch overhead of the staged path. Per-call device/property/occupancy queries and cooperative-launch overhead may erase that gain, so the experiment must time the full run() call and retain the regular fallback when the target rejects the actual launch.
data.notes: This repairs the prior build failure caused by undefined __uint_as_int calls using a defined mapping from modulo-2^32 bits to signed int. The candidate has not been compiled, correctness-tested, or timed here. Cooperative support remains unverified until the controller attempts the launch; unsupported or rejected launches fall back to the original path. Keep host query/setup overhead in full-program timing; no speedup is claimed.
transformations: Replace undefined __uint_as_int uses with a conversion that preserves modulo-2^32 reduction semantics and performs only representable signed conversions.

Retain the cooperative grid-stride reduction with an occupancy-bounded resident grid, grid-wide synchronization, per-CTA scratch partials, and a single CTA final sum; preserve the launch-failure fallback.
